messages:
tara: Quick sync 1: were prepping listings for AWS/GCP/Azure + a joint announcement with ACME HW. Need a crosscloud checklist and one-liner differences for the press kit. Owners?
ben: I can do cloud infra templates + Azure key policy. Will also run a staging deploy to confirm marketplace entitlement flows.
anika: I'll own SKU/product packaging and the pricing matrix. Need to decide between token-units vs seat bundles for the announcement.
mike: I'll handle systems integrator (SI) playbook for partners (deployment steps, example infra) and a short FAQ.
sophie: Legal will review the announcement language and the marketplace contracts. Please tag any compliance/regional clauses.
raj: I'll coordinate assets and the marketing one-pager. Need product blurbs + hero screenshot from dev by EOD. @leo can you help with the press blurb?
leo: Yup - will draft the 2-sentence headline + blurb. Need the exact product name and trial terms.
ara: (out-of-thread note) vendor intake form says we need a hardware mention in listing description for ACME integration.
ben: Azure KMS snippet (minimal) to include in docs:
```json
{"keyId":"alias/redwood-marketplace","rotationEnabled":true,"rotationPeriod":"365d"}
```
anika: Pricing experiment idea: public listing shows token-units; private offer maps tokens -> seats for enterprise. Draft manifest excerpt:
```yaml
sku: rwinf-acme-edge
tier: cloud
metering: token_units
trial_days: 30
```
mike: SI note: ACME HW customers want offline deploy instructions and an image with preinstalled runtime. I'll add a short checklist.
sophie: For announcement, we need: (1) approved logo usage from ACME legal, (2) compliant EULA excerpt, (3) customer data flow blurb. I'm OK to sign off once those are in.
marketplace-bot: Checklist created: MP-9987 (crosscloud-acme-listing) assigned to ben, anika, mike, sophie. https://internal.redwood/marketplace/MP-9987
raj: Asset checklist: hero image (2 sizes), 3 screenshots, 1 animated gif, press one-pager PDF. I'll collect from design and tag here.
leo: Draft headline: "Redwood Inference partners with ACME to bring low-latency on-device inference via cloud marketplace" - feedback?
tara: Nice start. Make it shorter: "Redwood + ACME: low-latency inference via cloud marketplaces." Keep legal happy.
ben: Infra blocker possibility: GCP requires a billing export for metering; need an account with billing enabled in staging. Can someone confirm?
anika: I can provision a billing-enabled test account for GCP staging.
mike: Also, SI onboarding: suggest a runbook step for customer support handoff and escalation matrix.
tara: Actions summary:
- ben: infra templates + Azure KMS policy + run staging deploy (due Tue)
- anika: SKU manifest + pricing split (token->seat mapping) + GCP staging billing (due Tue)
- mike: SI playbook + offline image checklist (due Wed)
- sophie: announcement legal review + EULA sample (due Tue morning)
- raj: marketing assets + press one-pager draft (due Tue noon)
- leo: headline + blurb + talk track (due Tue morning)
marketplace-bot: Reminder MP-9987 preflight run at 3100000300.
tara: If ACME legal needs a specific clause for hardware mention, ping Sophie and I'll loop in partner-ops. Thanks all :partyparrot:
